sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "weekly_weather"."day_of_week" AS g, AVG("weekly_weather"."precipitation") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("weekly_weather"."low_temperature" - "weekly_weather"."high_temperature") AS REAL) / "weekly_weather"."high_temperature")) AS m2 FROM "weekly_weather"  GROUP BY "weekly_weather"."day_of_week"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL
quantities: weekly_weather.relative difference of daily low temperature from daily high temperature
why: average of chance of precipitation per weekly_weather.day_of_week
(daily low temperature - daily high temperature) / daily high temperature: the relative difference of two quantities in celsius
average of relative difference of daily low temperature from daily high temperature per weekly_weather.day_of_week
gap to the all average of average of chance of precipitation (all level)
